title: 第23章 时光飞逝第24章 皇龙剑派
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
数日后。
竹林，剑影。
满地落叶翩飞。
即便只是一把木剑，也被舞的像模像样。
“不错，横劈的力度再大一点！”洺万里站在一旁，笑着摸下巴上的胡子。
朔衡手臂发力，猛然一挥。
嚓——
剑气形成一道雪白的剑弧扩散，发出尖锐的破空声。
翠竹倏动。
竹叶碰撞间，沙沙的响声不绝于耳。
舞完最后一剑，朔衡收势，拿起一旁并未被波及半分的茶水喝了一口。
洺万里笑呵呵的走上前来。
“练习剑法并非只是为了让你记住招式，而是将其融会贯通，能在战斗里随意用出其中任何剑招。
如此，方才算你学明白了这剑法。”
朔衡点点头。
学以致用嘛，他懂的。
“现在有了基础，你可以开始练习雷鸣剑影了。”
不懂剑，自然无法将剑技融会贯通。
这也是洺万里把天阙剑法传给朔衡的原因。
雷鸣剑影，最重要的，便是其中“雷鸣”二字，讲究一个出其不意的迅捷。

而对雷鸣剑影的熟练程度，也可以从使用剑技时爆发的雷鸣之音来判断。
寻常人若是能做到挥剑的那一刻同时产生雷鸣，已是极限。
但洺万里对朔衡的要求自然更高。
雷鸣剑影的最高境界——剑先至，雷后鸣。
“好好练吧。”洺万里拍了拍朔衡的脑袋，“这段时间，先别出峰。”
朔衡眨眨眼睛：“师父，是上次的事？”
“嗯。”
关于这一点，洺万里没有太过隐瞒的意思：“那不是你现在的实力可以掺和的，等你未来突破金丹，才有资格了解其中情况。”
朔衡本来也没想上赶着去送死：“那人抓到了吗？”
“他倒是聪明。”洺万里笑了笑，“派人去时，已经人去楼空了。
想来是杀完了人，不敢过多停留。”
这也是朔衡想不通的一点。
“师父，既然他们知道不可能在仙宫中掀起太大的风浪，为什么还要为了放弃潜伏而暴露自己以至于被迫离开仙宫？
若是需要修士的性命来完成一些东西，散修难道不是更好的选择吗？”
洺万里一直都知道朔衡聪慧。
但当朔衡真的把这份智慧摆在他面前时，他反而有些惊奇。
不过他还是认真的回答了朔衡的问题。
“或许他们的目的已经达到了。”
洺万里目光深远，“让我们产生猜忌，亦或是一种来自他们的警告。”
content_en:
A few days later.
Bamboo forest, sword shadow.
Fallen leaves are flying all over the ground.
Even if it is just a wooden sword, it is danced in a decent way.
"That's right, the horizontal chop should be stronger!" Ming Wanli stood aside, smiling and stroking the beard on his chin.
Shuo Heng exerted his strength and waved suddenly.
Cha——
The sword energy formed a snow-white sword arc and spread, making a sharp sound of breaking through the air.
The green bamboo suddenly moved.
When the bamboo leaves collide, the sound of rustling is endless.
After finishing the last sword dance, Shuo Heng stopped, picked up the tea that was not affected at all and took a sip.
Ming Wanli walked forward with a smile.
“Practicing swordsmanship is not just for you to memorize the moves, but to master them so that you can use any of them in battle.
In this way, it can be considered that you have understood this sword technique. "
Shuo Heng nodded.
He knows how to apply what he has learned.
"Now that you have the foundation, you can start practicing Thunder Sword Shadow."
If you don't understand swords, you will naturally not be able to master sword skills.
This is also the reason why Ming Wanli passed on the Tianque sword technique to Shuo Heng.
The most important thing about the Thunder Sword Shadow is the word "Thunder", which emphasizes unexpected swiftness.
The proficiency of Thunder Sword Shadow can also be judged from the thunderous sound that erupts when using sword skills.
If an ordinary person could produce thunder at the same moment when he swings his sword, that would be the limit.
But Ming Wanli naturally had higher requirements for Shuo Heng.
The highest state of the thundering sword shadow - the sword comes first, then the thunder roars.
"Practice hard." Ming Wanli patted Shuo Heng on the head, "Don't go out of your way during this period."
Shuo Heng blinked: "Master, is this what happened last time?"
"Yeah."
Regarding this point, Ming Wanli did not mean to hide it too much: "That is not something you can mix with your current strength. Only when you break through the golden elixir in the future will you be qualified to understand the situation."
Shuo Heng originally didn't want to rush to die: "Has that person been caught?"
"He is quite smart." Ming Wanli smiled, "When we sent people there, the building was already empty.
I guess I finished killing everyone and didn't dare to stay too long. "
This is something Shuo Heng couldn't figure out.
"Master, since they know that they can't cause too much trouble in the Immortal Palace, why do they expose themselves and be forced to leave the Immortal Palace in order to give up hiding?
If a monk's life is needed to complete something, isn't casual cultivating a better choice? "
Ming Wanli always knew that Shuo Heng was smart.
But when Shuo Heng actually put this wisdom in front of him, he was a little surprised.
However, he still answered Shuo Heng's question seriously.
"Perhaps their goal has been achieved."
Ming Wanli's eyes were far-reaching, "It makes us suspicious, or it's a warning from them."
